title: wkdoctor SDK Health Check REF
desc: T3 reference tier of wkdoctor-sdk-environment-health-check. Full check list, robustness rationale, plugin status, symlink + defender check details.
steps: FULL CHECK LIST (11): wkappbot.exe presence+version, wkappbot-core.exe, a11y.exe (warn), Eye tick ctx%, dotnet 8 SDK, skills catalog count, nightly-guard in settings.json, bin in PATH, .wkappbot config.json, wkappbot.hq dir, Defender dev-exclusions (06).
ROBUSTNESS: checks use file/process/PE-version APIs only -- zero wkappbot subprocess calls (avoids Eye IPC stall in subprocess context).
PLUGIN MODULES: 01-binaries, 02-runtime, 03-skills, 04-config, 05-hq, 06-defender-exclusions, 50-symlink. Orchestrator = thin dot-source loader.

SYMLINK CHECK (50): auto-detects+repairs broken VS Code extension cdx.exe symlinks. Candidates under WKAppBot/bin and wkappbot-sdk/bin. Repair source: latest openai.chatgpt extension dir, fallback sandbox-bin. Reports ok/warn/fail.

DEFENDER CHECK (06, added 2026-06-02): detects missing Defender exclusions for dev hot-folders (D:/GitHub, .claude, Temp/claude) + 6 dev procs + ScanAvgCPULoadFactor>20 -- the MsMpEng real-time scan storm (CPU spike + keyboard freeze) cause. Auto-repair: Add-MpPreference admin-direct or self-elevating UAC; Tamper-Protection caveat -> Defender GUI. Skill: defender-dev-exclusions.
HISTORY: 2026-05-25 v1.0 (10 checks). 2026-06-02 added Defender check (SDK commit 840a971a) + 3-tier split.
